description: OpenStreetMap node/4184340020. The inscription records that a Königsberg Red Banner regiment was based at Osovtsy airfield at Byaroza FROM 1955 TO 2010 — the airframe is therefore from the Belarusian Air Force period

OpenStreetMap node/4184340022. The inscription honours the heroic airmen of the 97th; 121st; 125th; 130th; 162nd; 207th and 212th bomber aviation regiments of the Second World War. A 1950s interceptor commemorating 1940s bomber crews — a substitution recorded here
